descricao: Mostra o espaco livre de cada disco local; limitePct mostra so discos com ate N% livre (exemplo do exercicio)

passos.comando: Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter 'DriveType=3' | Select-Object DeviceID, @{n='LivreGB';e={[math]::Round($_.FreeSpace/1GB,1)}}, @{n='TotalGB';e={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,1)}}, @{n='LivrePct';e={[math]::Round(100*$_.FreeSpace/$_.Size,0)}} | Where-Object { $_.LivrePct -le {{limitePct}} } | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200
